state.background: B3d implements the JEV-approved two-row CAGR viewport pair. The existing tests/browser-mode/CagrPanel.browser.test.tsx mounts actual CagrPanel/useCagrState with deterministic two-row CPI data. It now has two additional named cases with explicit 375x667 portrait and 667x375 landscape Browser Mode viewports, verifies window dimensions, applies an explicit fixture CSS baseline, opens/calculates the component result, and checks result visibility plus the mapped bottom bounds. The focused file passed 3/3, including the pre-existing interaction test and both new cases. The Playwright source retains route trigger integration while removing only the mapped local result/geometry slices. No E2E was run because the cadence from the last consolidated E2E is 2/20 toward the next 20 named-case gate.
acceptanceCriteria: The focused Browser Mode file tests/browser-mode/CagrPanel.browser.test.tsx passed 3/3: the existing CagrPanel dialog/start-year/result case plus portrait and landscape cases.

The new tests mount actual CagrPanel/useCagrState with deterministic chart data, set and verify 375x667 and 667x375 respectively, and explicitly apply the documented fixture CSS baseline rather than assuming globals.css is loaded.

Portrait removes P42-061 result visibility, P42-062 detail bottom <=667, and P42-063 note bottom <=667 from the component geometry source group. P42-060 remains in Playwright as the live production trigger-to-dialog check.

Landscape removes P42-065 result visibility and P42-066 detail bottom <= window.innerHeight+1 from the component geometry source group. P42-064 remains in Playwright as the live production trigger-to-dialog check.

Playwright retains live #section-stacked intersection/scroll, production trigger visibility/click and resulting dialog integration, and production page-shell placement. No production route/data or page-shell guarantee is claimed by the isolated Browser Mode cases.

The initial focused attempt used unsupported page.locator API; the test was corrected to supported Browser Mode viewport/locator APIs before the recorded final 3/3 result. This earlier attempt is historical and not an unresolved failure.
No E2E was run because the current counter is 2/20 from the last consolidated E2E. Do not run E2E until 20 further named Browser Mode cases pass.
Both stable rows remain partial; A=123/E=90/M=1 is unchanged. This work does not increment M or claim either whole row migrated.
verification: Focused Browser Mode result supplied for this checkpoint: tests/browser-mode/CagrPanel.browser.test.tsx, 3/3 passed, including both new cases.

Source diff: P42-061/-062/-063 removed from portrait T-E2E-8; P42-065/-066 removed from landscape T-E2E-9. P42-060/-064 are retained with production-trigger route integration checks; the actual live #section-stacked setup and page-shell route remain Playwright-owned.

An initial test authoring attempt called unsupported page.locator; the final implementation uses the supported Browser Mode viewport/locator APIs, passes focused verification, and has explicit viewport/baseline checks.
No E2E command was run due the 2/20 cadence. No full-suite result is claimed here.
knownConstraints: Geometry is bounded to the explicitly declared isolated fixture CSS baseline; it does not establish production Geist font or page-shell placement.
Route trigger, live chart intersection/scroll, production data wiring, and page-shell position remain in Playwright.
The overall stable rows remain partial and the next consolidated E2E gate is deferred until 20 further named Browser Mode tests pass.

implementation.instructions: Select exactly one mutually exclusive criterion for the B3d implementation checkpoint.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The implementation and focused evidence satisfy the approved B3d scope and retained route boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The implementation contradicts an applicable assertion ownership or acceptance requirement.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is absent and prevents assessment.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The implementation or evidence is too incomplete to assess the defined checkpoint.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation defect or unsupported behavior remains.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation exceeds the two partial assertion slices or weakens retained E2E boundaries.
criteria.other: A material issue does not fit the other criteria.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence does not support a reliable determination.
